title: wkroot
desc: T1 usage core for wkroot.cmd: launch a root-mode agent of any family on a working folder with HANDOFF processing. Spec and acceptance tests live in wkroot-launcher.
steps: USAGE: wkroot.cmd <working-folder> <prompt> -model <sonnet|codex-luna|agy-flash|...>. ROSTER: wkroot.cmd roots -json -alive prints only alive roots (spokesman 99e78c05, 2026-10-06: plain roots -json printed 113 KB of 467 records, 2 alive); use it as the spokesman first call. SPEC (owner 2026-10-10, a personal-docs root died unnoticed while roots -alive still listed others by lease): -alive must mean the session record ChildPid process exists (Get-Process on .tmp/wkroot-sessions/SID.json ChildPid), not that a lease file is present; print a pid column and drop rows whose loop is gone. LIVE STATE, NOT A PID GUESS (owner 2026-10-10: the root tool misjudges whether a root is alive; use hippo records, open parallel and serial work, completion and time): one module Get-WkRootLiveState gives each root a State from five signals: (1) ChildPid exists and its name is a family host; (2) PID reuse refused when the process started over 2 min after the record Started; (3) last activity = newest write of the transcript, its subagents folder or the inbox, and for codex, agy and grok the transcript path comes from the wkhippo indexer; (4) open work = tool calls without a result plus background launches without a completion notice in the transcript tail; (5) WORKING if active within 2 min, WAITING if open work and silent at most 30 min, IDLE if no open work (the loop waits for its inbox, so a tell only queues), STALE if open work but silent past 30 min, DEAD if the pid is gone or reused. -alive prints State, IdleMin and Pending. SPOKESMEN ALWAYS LISTED (owner 2026-10-10): roots -json carries a spokesmen array of every spokesman session, ended or not, with State (WORKING, IDLE, ENDED), IdleMin and the count of roots it commands; -alive never filters it. Until it lands, the spokesman checks each ChildPid with Get-Process at every turn open. Quote a backslash folder path when calling from bash. Run from bash as ./wkroot.cmd or by absolute path; the child prompt gets agent-on-load plus family skill reads and a HANDOFF.md pointer. //why:roster state field confirmed four roots kept running //why:alive roster showed docs root despite exit notice-opus //why:four ChildPids still ran after their waiting shells died-opus //why:roster state field confirmed four roots kept running-opus

ORDER IN THE PROMPT, NOT ONLY IN A FILE (measured 2026-10-11): write 'Your FIRST tool call reads .tmp/ORDER.md' into the launch prompt and check the root's first reply names that file; three resumed agy roots answered only with skill reads for 90 minutes and landed none of their orders. DETACHED LAUNCH (kih 369fad5b5, 2026-10-11): wkroot starts the -run child through Start-WkRootDetached (WMI Win32_Process.Create, parent WmiPrvSE), so the launch prints [wkroot] detached run pid N log PATH, then WAITS on that pid and streams its log (kih 4b2fc81ca; -nowait returns at once), so each live root shows one shell to the owner and the root survives a reaped or closed spokesman shell (proved 2026-10-12: Claude Code reaped all four waiting shells for low memory and roots 21148, 20624, 10168, 21020 kept running). Reaping is Claude Code's own; the owner turns it off only by starting Claude Code with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP=1 in its environment (setting it from a shell has no effect). A root launched before the wait landed gets a watcher shell: . tools/Start-WkRootDetached.ps1; Wait-WkRootDetached -ProcessId N -LogPath LOG (run in background). Example: WKAppBot root 530914c1 kept running as pid 34876 after its launcher shell exited 0; check it with Get-Process -Id N and the log tail. //why:contest order file named first in send text-opus //why:contest root must open order file on first call-opus //why:second reap today killed only four waiting shells-sonnet

MODEL UPGRADE CONTINUES THE SAME SESSION (owner 2026-09-28, after a spokesman launched a fresh sonnet beside a 1.7MB haiku root): when a root crosses a ladder line or the work outgrows its model, run wkroot.cmd REPO PROMPT -resume SID -model sonnet on THAT root's session id, never a fresh launch -- a fresh session loses everything the root already learned and puts two sessions in one repo. Only a retired root past omega is replaced by a rookie. //why:bloated appbot root needs rookie after descent order //why:three roots resumed on their own sessions, all WORKING-sonnet //why:resume kept the sdk kih and appbot memory-sonnet //why:bloated appbot root needs rookie after descent order-sonnet

ROUTING (owner 2026-09-25): -model AUTO-ASSIGNS BY SIZE when omitted (owner 2026-09-28, supersedes the mandatory rule): with no -model, wkroot picks the ladder model by transcript MB -- a fresh launch (~0MB, no -resume) defaults to haiku, and -resume reads that session transcript MB and applies <2MB haiku / 2-4MB sonnet / >=4MB opus; an explicit NON-CLAUDE -model always wins. MODEL LOTTERY IS SPEC (owner 2026-10-02, restated 2026-10-05): on a FRESH launch, no -model OR a CLAUDE model named (haiku, sonnet, opus) is replaced by a weighted lottery over the youngest model of every family (haiku 10, codex-luna 45, agy-flash 45; an exhausted family is skipped since kih ab64a6311, but it only reads .tmp/wkroot-family-limits.txt and nothing wrote a 429 into it, so 2026-10-12 it drew agy-flash at 429 with 99h left; first aid: append FAMILY TAB RESET_UTC TAB note to that file (proved: Get-WkRootExhaustedFamilies printed agy-flash), the auto-writer is the TODO step; DO re-inherit on another family WHEN a root log shows AGY_ERROR RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 429 Individual quota reached: wkroot.cmd REPO PROMPT -inherit SID -model sonnet. Example: 2026-10-11 agy quota reset was 105h away, WKAppBot root 530914c1 resumed as sonnet 2c71018e), and wkroot prints [wkroot] model lottery picked NAME; this is not a bug, so never report it as one. Only a non-Claude -model (codex-luna, agy-flash) on a fresh launch, or any -model on -resume, is obeyed exactly. To get a Claude model for sure, resume an existing Claude session with -resume SID -model sonnet. Code: wkappbot-kih tools/wkroot-codex.ps1 line 139. Build a pure Get-WkRootAutoModel(sizeMB,isResume) in the wkroot-codex.ps1 arg parse replacing the -model-missing exit 2. TODO: land this via a sector proto + selftest (0MB->haiku, 1.9->haiku, 2.5->sonnet, 4.1->opus, explicit-overrides). ORIGINAL: -model named the exact model (sonnet, codex-luna, agy-flash). -family and -tier were REMOVED and are refused with exit 2, because Agent.ps1 let -Family silently override -Model. Child skill refs are chosen from the model name; every named ref must score >=60 or the child's tier-gate refuses its first dispatch (agy-harness-integration-guide at 20 did exactly that 2026-09-25, swapped for cross-family-harness-integration). A failed child is NOT re-run; the direct fallback fires only when wkappbot exec never started the child (the .started marker is absent). //why:short sid suffix guess failed, full uuid resumed //why:quota stop module wired into run loop-opus //why:codex blocked and agy exhausted, d532588e resume gave sonnet root-haiku //why:short sid suffix guess failed, full uuid resumed-opus
SEE ALSO: wkappbot skill read wkroot-launcher (spec, acceptance tests, known bugs); wkappbot skill read codex-tool-wrappers (codex backend).

NAVIGATION: wkappbot skill read wkroot (T1 usage core, this skill); wkappbot skill read wkroot-howto (T2 spec: family adapter spec, milestone gate, HANDOFF forwarding). INCIDENT 2026-09-27: a spokesman authorized only for one repo used wkroot to launch and command roots in two sibling repos already patrolled by other spokesmen -- roots -json prints a spokesman id per record but nothing in wkroot/send/tell checks it before acting. RULE: before launching or telling/sending a root, read the existing record's spokesman field (use -json, the plain table truncates it) and refuse if it is set and differs from your own session id. TODO: code this as Test-WkRootCommandAllowed in wkroot-send.ps1 (empty target allowed, matching allowed, mismatch blocked unless -Force, -Force still logs both ids) -- sector builds proto+selftest, ROOT wires. //why:usage lock should require spokesman skills //why:usage lock should require spokesman skills-sonnet

SPEC, FORCED STUDY FROM THE ROOT TOOL (owner 2026-10-05, his words: trace the reflex trajectory inside the root tool and call the forced-like harness function when something needed is unread, and the on-load lock enforces it; no patchwork hook blocks, the nudge skill carries the list). WHEN: every wkroot.cmd launch, send and tell. HOW: read the required ids from this skill's own Require lines of the form wkappbot skill read ID (one source, no second list), ask wkhippo studied --ids LIST --session CALLER_SID --since SESSION_START --json which are unread, and for each unread id call Add-WkForcedStudy (tools/wkharness-common-forcedstudy/Add-WkForcedStudy.ps1, Msg containing wkappbot skill read ID, SessionId the caller session) so the existing on-load lock refuses everything except knowledge ops until the skills are read; print one line naming the unread skills and still exit normally. FAIL OPEN on an unknown caller session, a missing helper or any error, never add a hook rule. VERIFY by a live round trip: an unread caller session gets the forced-study ledger line and the next non-knowledge call is refused by the on-load lock, a session that read them gets no ledger line.

CODEX ROOTS CANNOT LAND (measured 2026-10-10, root 1499a6ef): a codex child runs as the sandbox user CodexSandboxOffline, so git worktree add fails with Permission denied on .git/worktrees and a clone it makes is owned by that user (dubious ownership for everyone else). For an order that must reach origin, launch a claude-family root (haiku, sonnet) or have the codex root write the fix as a .tmp proto plus its exit output, and the spokesman lands it from a clean worktree: git worktree add --detach .tmp/wt-NAME origin/main, apply, commit by pathspec, git push origin HEAD:main. Example: QA roster fix 4cca1d04f landed this way. //why:explains zero codex commits across sdk and wkappbot today //why:explains zero codex commits across sdk and wkappbot today-opus

RESULT kih 4e9210899, selftest 5/5, not yet proven by a live 429 or a live codex fallback: (2026-10-12) the lottery must skip a family whose quota is known exhausted and the codex-budget fallback must launch fresh, never reuse the codex -resume id. Measured: -model sonnet drew agy-flash then 429 Resets in 99h; -resume bf6218d6 -model codex-luna fell back to sonnet with the codex id, claude printed No conversation found. Proof wanted: selftest where a cached agy 429 makes the lottery pick only haiku or codex, and a codex-blocked resume falls back to a fresh claude session id.
